# This code book is for generating plots and some preliminary tests.

diversity plots.

## Alpha diversity

```{r}
biom@otu_table <- otu_table(subset(biom@otu_table,select = meta$ID))
alpha_div2 <- estimate_richness(t(biom@otu_table), measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson"))
alpha_div2 <- cbind(rownames(alpha_div2), alpha_div2)
colnames(alpha_div2)[1] <- "ID"
alpha_div2$ID <- str_remove(alpha_div2$ID, "X")

# alpha_check <- alpha_div2[alpha_div2$Observed]

data <- merge(alpha_div2, meta, by="ID")
data$pet_status = factor(data$pet_status, levels = c("No Pet", "Cat Only", "Dog Only", "Cat and Dog"))

# remove(alpha,meta)
```


```{r}
library(ggpubr)
g1 <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = pet_status, y = Observed, fill = pet_status))+geom_violin(alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA)+
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test",
                     label.x = 1.5,
                     label.y = max(data$Observed)*1.1)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No Pet" = "#999999", "Cat Only" = "#E69F00", "Dog Only" = "#56B4E9", "Cat and Dog" = "#009E73"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(x = "Pet Type", y = "Observed")

g2 <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = pet_status, y = Chao1, fill = pet_status))+geom_violin(alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA)+
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test",
                     label.x = 1.5,
                     label.y = max(data$Chao1)*1.1)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No Pet" = "#999999", "Cat Only" = "#E69F00", "Dog Only" = "#56B4E9", "Cat and Dog" = "#009E73"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(x = "Pet Type", y = "Chao1")

g3 <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = pet_status, y = Shannon, fill = pet_status))+geom_violin(alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA)+
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test",
                     label.x = 1.5,
                     label.y = max(data$Shannon)*1.1)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No Pet" = "#999999", "Cat Only" = "#E69F00", "Dog Only" = "#56B4E9", "Cat and Dog" = "#009E73"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(x = "Pet Type", y = "Shannon")

g4 <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = pet_status, y = Simpson, fill = pet_status))+geom_violin(alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", outlier.shape = NA)+
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test",
                     label.x = 1.5,
                     label.y = max(data$Simpson)*1.1)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No Pet" = "#999999", "Cat Only" = "#E69F00", "Dog Only" = "#56B4E9", "Cat and Dog" = "#009E73"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(x = "Pet Type", y = "Simpson")

library(patchwork)
four_panel_figure <- (g1+g2)/(g3+g4)+
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")+
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

print(four_panel_figure)
ggsave("/N/u/liaozh/Quartz/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/Analysis/Results/plots/four_panel_combine.png",
four_panel_figure,
       type = "cairo",
  width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)

```

### test difference
In this small brief section, I am going to test their difference among groups.
```{r}
summary(aov(Observed~pet_status, data = data))
summary(aov(Chao1~pet_status, data = data))
summary(aov(Shannon~pet_status, data = data))
summary(aov(Simpson~pet_status, data = data))
```

## Beta diversity
```{r}
dist_matrix <- vegdist(t(biom@otu_table), method = "bray")
pcoa_res = cmdscale(dist_matrix, k = 2, eig = T)
pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_df$pet_status <- meta$pet_status
ggsave("/N/u/liaozh/Quartz/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/Analysis/Results/plots/PCoA.png",
ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = pet_status, shape = pet_status))+
  # geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_point(size = 0.9)+
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = pet_status), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.1, show.legend = F)+
  labs(title = "Microbiota PCoA by Pet Ownership",
       x = "PCoA 1", y = "PCoA 2", fill = "Pet Type")+
  theme_minimal()+
  coord_fixed(),
       type = "cairo",
  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


## Stacked bar plot
```{r}
ind <- which(apply(biom@otu_table,1,function(x){
  mean(x>0)
})>0.1)
biom@otu_table <- biom@otu_table[ind,]

ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(biom, function(x) x/sum(x))
df <- psmelt(ps_rel)

df_no <- df%>%filter(Sample%in%meta$ID[meta$pet_status=="No Pet"])
df_no <- aggregate(Abundance~OTU + Rank1 + Rank2, data = df_no, FUN = mean)
df_no$pet_status = "No Pet"

df_cat <- df%>%filter(Sample%in%meta$ID[meta$pet_status=="Cat Only"])
df_cat <- aggregate(Abundance~OTU + Rank1 + Rank2, data = df_cat, FUN = mean)
df_cat$pet_status = "Cat Only"

df_dog <- df%>%filter(Sample%in%meta$ID[meta$pet_status=="Dog Only"])
df_dog <- aggregate(Abundance~OTU + Rank1 + Rank2, data = df_dog, FUN = mean)
df_dog$pet_status = "Dog Only"

df_both <- df%>%filter(Sample%in%meta$ID[meta$pet_status=="Cat and Dog"])
df_both <- aggregate(Abundance~OTU + Rank1 + Rank2, data = df_both, FUN = mean)
df_both$pet_status = "Cat and Dog"

df_test = rbind(df_no,df_cat,df_dog,df_both)
ggsave("/N/u/liaozh/Quartz/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/Analysis/Results/plots/Stack Bar.png",
ggplot(df_test, aes(x = pet_status, y = Abundance, fill = str_remove(Rank2, "p__")))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance", x = "Pet Type", fill = "Taxa Class"),
       type = "cairo",
  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```




## Ridge plot for Taxa Identification result

```{r}
library(ggridges)
data_whole_DA <- read.csv("/N/u/liaozh/Quartz/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/Analysis/Results/otu_test/07202026result/res_pair.csv")
data_DA <- read.csv("/N/u/liaozh/Quartz/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/Analysis/Results/otu_test/07202026result/res_pair.csv")
data_taxa <- read.csv("/N/u/liaozh/Quartz/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/Analysis/Results/otu_test/07202026result/taxa_name.csv")
colnames(data_taxa)[1] <- "taxon"
data_DA <- merge(data_DA,subset(data_taxa,select = c(taxon, Rank3)), by = "taxon", all.x = T)
data_DA$Rank3 <- str_remove(data_DA$Rank3, "c__")
data_whole_DA$Rank3 <- "Total"

# Only need to plot a subset of taxa.
data_DA <- data_DA%>%
  filter(Rank3%in%c("Mollicutes", "Erysipelotrichi", "Coriobacteriia", "Deltaproteobacteria",
                    "Betaproteobacteria", "Gammaproteobacteria", "Bacilli","Actinobacteria"))

sub_ridge1 <- ggplot(data_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusCat.Only, y = Rank3, fill = Rank3))+
  geom_density_ridges(data = data_whole_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusCat.Only,fill = NULL), color = "grey70", fill = "grey95", size = 0.3, alpha = 1)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1,0,1), labels = c("-1", "0", "1"))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray", linewidth = 0.5)+
  geom_density_ridges()+
  scale_fill_brewer()+
  theme_ridges()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")
  )+
  xlab("LFC Cat-and-dog vs Cat-only")+
  ylab("")

ridge1 <- ggplot(data_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusDog.Only, y = Rank3, fill = Rank3))+
  geom_density_ridges(data = data_whole_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusDog.Only,fill = NULL), color = "grey70", fill = "grey95", size = 0.3, alpha = 1)+
  geom_density_ridges()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1,0,1), labels = c("-1", "0", "1"))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray", linewidth = 0.5)+
  geom_density_ridges()+
  scale_fill_brewer()+
  theme_ridges()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")
  )+
  xlab("LFC Cat-and-dog vs Dog-only")+
  ylab("")

sub_ridge2 <- ggplot(data_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusNo.Pet, y = Rank3, fill = Rank3))+
  geom_density_ridges(data = data_whole_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusNo.Pet,fill = NULL), color = "grey70", fill = "grey95", size = 0.3, alpha = 1)+
  geom_density_ridges()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1,0,1), labels = c("-1", "0", "1"))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray", linewidth = 0.5)+
  geom_density_ridges()+

ridge2 <- ggplot(data_DA, aes(x = lfc_pet_statusDog.Only_pet_statusCat.Only, y = Rank3, fill = Rank3))+

ridge3 <- ggplot(data_DA, aes(x = -lfc_pet_statusNo.Pet_pet_statusCat.Only, y = Rank3, fill = Rank3))+
```

# Then goes through some statistical tests

## PERMANOVA test for sample distance

```{r}
dist_matrix <- distance(biom, method = "bray")

permanova_res <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ pet_status, data = meta, permutations = 999)
# significant result
# devtools::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis")
library(pairwiseAdonis)
pairwise_res <- pairwise.adonis(dist_matrix, meta$pet_status)
```
